  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "You are researching an AI tool for artificial.one, an AI tools review platform.

TOOL TO RESEARCH: " + ($json['Tool Name'] || $json.name || $json.title || 'Unknown') + "
SOURCE URL: " + ($json['Deal URL'] || $json.url || '') + "

Use web search to gather:
1. Official description from the tool's website
2. Full feature list with specific capabilities
3. All pricing tiers (monthly, annual, lifetime if available)
4. At least 3 direct competitors in the same category
5. Any user reviews or testimonials (summarize sentiment)
6. Screenshots or demo availability

Return ONLY a JSON object with this structure:
{\n  \"tool_name\": \"...\",\n  \"category\": \"...\",\n  \"description\": \"...\",\n  \"features\": [\"feature1\", \"feature2\", ...],\n  \"pricing\": {\n    \"monthly\": \"$X\",\n    \"annual\": \"$X\",\n    \"lifetime\": \"$X or null\"\n  },\n  \"competitors\": [\"comp1\", \"comp2\", \"comp3\"],\n  \"user_sentiment\": \"...\",\n  \"review_count\": X,\n  \"deal_url\": \"...\"\n}"
  }]
}
